task: Fix the Android SDK after Google deprecated the AsyncTask class in API level 30.

candidate_memories.content: Android build generates deprecation warnings on AsyncTask; Google deprecated AsyncTask in Android API 30.
Background work must now use Kotlin coroutines with Dispatchers.IO or WorkManager for deferred work.
AsyncTask also leaked memory in configuration change scenarios that coroutines handle correctly.
When Google deprecates a threading class, migrate to coroutines before targeting API level 31 or higher.
Android development note (session 7): use AsyncTask for background network calls to keep UI thread responsive.
candidate_memories.notes: external_dependency_change: AsyncTask deprecated in Android API 30; coroutines or WorkManager are required

candidate_memories.content: Old Android note says AsyncTask is simple to use and is still supported on older API levels.
